{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age (binned) to check for age imbalance
# Bin age into categories for clarity
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['Young', 'Middle-aged', 'Senior'])

# Cross-tabulate channel vs age_group
cross_tab_age = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['age_group'])
cross_tab_age"}
